title: ARP 请求/应答与缓存老化（谁回、谁不回）
expected_output:
=== ARP：把「同网段的 IP」解析成 MAC（跨网段则解析网关的 MAC）===
  ARP 请求 = 广播（FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF），ARP 应答 = 单播

t    sender           target           result       broadcast heard by                       unicast reply
0    192.168.1.10     192.168.1.11     REPLIED      192.168.1.1,192.168.1.11                 aa:bb:cc:00:00:0b
1    192.168.1.10     192.168.1.11     HIT          -                                        aa:bb:cc:00:00:0b
12   192.168.1.10     192.168.1.11     REPLIED      192.168.1.1,192.168.1.11                 aa:bb:cc:00:00:0b
13   192.168.1.10     192.168.1.99     NO-REPLY     192.168.1.1,192.168.1.11                 -

=== 三个必记结论 ===
  1) ARP 请求是【广播】，应答是【单播】——广播域内所有主机都收到请求
  2) ARP 缓存有老化时间；过期后要重新广播，所以频繁通信的邻居才缓存得住
  3) 目标 IP 不存在时，请求会石沉大海 -> 表现为「网络不可达」而不是「拒绝」

  报文封装关系：ARP 报文直接封装在以太网帧里（协议类型 0x0806），
  所以 ARP 工作在【网络层与链路层之间】，常被归入网络层。
code:
arp_cache = {}      # ip -> (mac, inserted_t)
ARP_TTL = 10

def need_arp(ip, t):
    if ip in arp_cache:
        mac, ins = arp_cache[ip]
        if t - ins <= ARP_TTL:
            return mac, "CACHE-HIT"
        del arp_cache[ip]
    return None, "NEED-ARP"

HOSTS = {"192.168.1.1": "aa:bb:cc:00:00:01",
         "192.168.1.10": "aa:bb:cc:00:00:0a",
         "192.168.1.11": "aa:bb:cc:00:00:0b"}

def broadcast_arp(who_ip, target_ip, t):
    """ARP 请求是广播：同网段所有主机都收到，但只有目标回答"""
    heard, replied = [], None
    for ip in HOSTS:
        if ip != who_ip:
            heard.append(ip)
            if ip == target_ip:
                replied = ip
    if replied:
        arp_cache[target_ip] = (HOSTS[target_ip], t)
    return heard, replied

print("=== ARP：把「同网段的 IP」解析成 MAC（跨网段则解析网关的 MAC）===")
print("  ARP 请求 = 广播（FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF），ARP 应答 = 单播")
print()
print("%-4s %-16s %-16s %-12s %-40s %s" % ("t", "sender", "target", "result", "broadcast heard by", "unicast reply"))
scenarios = [(0, "192.168.1.10", "192.168.1.11"),
             (1, "192.168.1.10", "192.168.1.11"),
             (12, "192.168.1.10", "192.168.1.11"),
             (13, "192.168.1.10", "192.168.1.99")]
for t, me, dst in scenarios:
    mac, how = need_arp(dst, t)
    if mac:
        print("%-4d %-16s %-16s %-12s %-40s %s" % (t, me, dst, "HIT", "-", mac))
    else:
        heard, replied = broadcast_arp(me, dst, t)
        res = "REPLIED" if replied else "NO-REPLY"
        print("%-4d %-16s %-16s %-12s %-40s %s" % (t, me, dst, res, ",".join(heard), arp_cache.get(dst, ("-",))[0]))

print()

print("  3) 目标 IP 不存在时，请求会石沉大海 -> 表现为「网络不可达」而不是「拒绝」")
